overview.description: The Corgi Robots & Humanoids ETF (CBOT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is actively managed to select stocks globally, of all capitalizations, tied to robotics and automation value change. In doing so, the fund seeks long-term capital appreciation. CBOT was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: CBOT is an equity ETF with a total of 26 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 14.02%, Alphabet at 10.83%, Aurora Innovation at 5.59%, UiPath at 5.22%, and Tesla at 5.03%.
